items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: gained his first professional jazz experience with organist Johnny “Hammond” Smith.

ctx.x: Guitarist John Abercrombie was born in Port Chester, New York on December 16, 1944. He attended the Berklee School of Music in the mid-60s and gained his first professional jazz experience with organist Johnny “Hammond” Smith.
His lengthy discography includes work with an impressive list of jazz luminaries. He is capable of playing in many stylistic settings and has led his own ensembles since the mid-1970s.
